title: Royale Equestrian Centre

services.name: Our Horses
services.desc: Beautiful Indoor Arena post frame construction, insulated roof and lots of natural light the riding area measures 72' x 182ft and features exceptional fibre footing to aid in reducing dust, and impact to the horse lower limbs and provides excellent cushion and traction. New 2022 - 2nd indoor arena that includes 9 box stalls, small heated tack and viewing lounge. 3 Outdoor Sand Rings. One dedicated for dressage and set up with competition quality dressage ring and letters. Second sand ring large dedicated show jumping ring measures 140' x 200' with lovely new show jumps and fillers. New 62’ x 132’ fully fenced sand ring for new riders and green horses Heated Tack room with individual lockers
